user.title: Connect to Chirp
user.description: Enter the address and port of your Chirp server and an API key. The key starts with chp_ and is stored on the Chirp host in /var/lib/chirp/api-key.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Chirp server, without http:// or a path.
data_description.port: Chirp listens on port 80 by default.
data_description.api_key: The Chirp API key (starts with chp_). Show it on the Chirp host with: cat /var/lib/chirp/api-key
data_description.ssl: Enable only when Chirp is served over HTTPS, for example behind a reverse proxy.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate on a server you trust. Applies only with HTTPS.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Chirp
reauth_confirm.description: The Chirp server rejected the stored API key. Enter a new API key for this server.

data_description.api_key: The Chirp API key (starts with chp_). Show it on the Chirp host with: cat /var/lib/chirp/api-key

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Chirp
reconfigure.description: Change the address of this Chirp server. The stored API key is reused and the server must be the same instance.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Chirp server, without http:// or a path.
data_description.port: Chirp listens on port 80 by default.
data_description.ssl: Enable only when Chirp is served over HTTPS, for example behind a reverse proxy.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate on a server you trust. Applies only with HTTPS.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by Chirp.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Chirp, or its response is invalid. Check the host, port and HTTPS setting.
error.invalid_host: Enter only a host name or IP address, without http:// or a path.
error.wrong_instance: This API key or address belongs to a different Chirp instance.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Chirp instance is already configured. Its address and API key were updated.
abort.wrong_instance: The server at this address is a different Chirp instance.

init.title: Chirp options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant polls Chirp.

data_description.scan_interval: Between 30 and 3600 seconds. Chirp itself refreshes SMART data on its own schedule.

refresh_failed.message: Could not ask Chirp to refresh SMART data. Check that the server is reachable.

refresh_auth_failed.message: Chirp rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration.

invalid_auth.message: Chirp rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration.

wrong_instance.message: A different Chirp instance answered at the configured address. Reconfigure the entry to point at the right server.
